data.title: Vivy · 雨中的伞与流浪狗
data.description: 游乐园闭园后的雨，她蹲在屋檐下为一只湿淋淋的流浪狗撑伞，裙摆浸在水里也不管；轻声哼着歌安抚它，伞全倾向了狗那边。
data.action: 游乐园闭园后的雨，她蹲在屋檐下为一只湿淋淋的流浪狗撑伞，裙摆浸在水里也不管
data.promptProse: Under the sheltering concrete eaves of a quiet park pavilion during an evening storm, Vivy kneels gently to angle her clear umbrella over a soaked, shivering stray dog huddled on the pavement. Golden doorway illumination from a nearby caretaker cottage washes across the wet park gravel, water puddles, and her compassionate, gentle android smile.
data.animaCaption: She tilts the umbrella over the soaked dog beneath the amusement-park eaves.
